description: Third Perspective submissions (ADRs 0109 to 0114), read and received by both crates/openblog-core/src/third_perspective.rs and web/components/third-perspective.js. A case's `request` (or its exact `text`) is received at `receivedAt` with a receipt whose digest is `receiptDigest`; `expect` is the canonical record, or the code of the first problem. `consentChanges` change a reader's consent through their receipt: `clarification` is the new clarification consent, and `feature` is the reader's choice about feature consent (ADR 0177), left out to keep it bound to the revision it was, `"decline"` to take it back, or the revision number the reader agrees to feature, which must be the revision they saw: `expect` is the copy's consent records afterwards, or the code. The attributed-section cases (ADR 0126) hold the reserved `ob-by-` anchor space to the same rule in the build and the browser.
